autoCreateTier1AndTier2(uint256).details: Aggregators are filtered to those still Active at call time and shuffled      using blockhash-based entropy. Reverts if fewer than T1_AGGREGATORS_PER_BATCH      active validators remain, or if fewer than T1_MODELS_PER_BATCH models passed.

claimDisputeBond().details: Pull payment: zeroes the balance before transferring (CEI).

closeLMsubmissionsEvaluation(uint256).details: Calls DINTaskAuditor.finalizeEvaluation; reverts if it returns false.

constructor.details: GI state is initialised to AwaitingDINTaskAuditorToBeSet; the model      owner must call setDINTaskAuditorContract before any other setup step.

params.modelId_: Model registry ID for this deployment, used for per-model stake enforcement.

createAuditorsBatches(uint256).details: Reverts if the auditor contract returns false (e.g. insufficient auditors).

endGI(uint256).details: Must be called after slashAggregators. Delegates the actual      client/auditor/aggregator/treasury split computation to      DINTaskAuditor.settleRewards (task_210726_6 §3) -- that contract      owns the client/auditor data (lmSubmissions, audit batches) this      contract doesn't have, and owns the giRewardPool/claimable      accounting so all three roles claim from one place.      This contract owns the T1/T2 aggregator batch data. Rather than      pass a per-(aggregator, finalized-batch) address list across the      interface (the pre-#125 shape, whose length was the settlement      divisor), it now passes only the scalar totalAggregatorWeight[_GI]      -- accumulated incrementally in finalizeT1Aggregation /      finalizeT2Aggregation. settleRewards snapshots it; claimReward      reads each aggregator's own aggregatorWeight[_GI][addr] from this      contract at claim time. No participant loop runs in either      settleRewards or endGI (BL-10).      The next startGI call will increment GI and transition state to      GIstarted.

finalizeT1Aggregation(uint256).details: Iterates all T1 batches; reverts on the first batch that has no submissions.

finalizeT2Aggregation(uint256).details: Reverts if the Tier-2 batch has received no submissions.

returns._0: Ordered array of aggregator addresses in registration order.

returns.finalized: True once a majority CID has been determined.
returns.modelIndexes: Indexes into the approved model list assigned to this batch.

getTier2Batch(uint256,uint256).details: _id must be 0; there is always exactly one Tier-2 batch per GI.

returns.finalized: True once a majority CID has been determined.
returns.validators: Aggregators assigned to the Tier-2 batch.

returns._0: The score set via setTier2Score for that GI.

openDispute(uint256,uint8,uint256).details: Caller must be an active validator and post `disputeBond` DIN,      within `disputeWindow` seconds of the batch's finalization.      Adjudication happens off-chain today (resolveDispute is      onlyOwner) -- see the scaffold-wide comment above the state      declarations for why.

params._GI: GI index the batch belongs to.
params.batchId: Index of the batch within its tier for that GI.
params.tierKind: Whether the batch is a Tier-1 or Tier-2 batch.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

registerDINaggregator(uint256).details: Caller must be an active validator; duplicate registrations revert.

releaseGIRegistrationSlots(uint256).details: Separated from endGI (task_100926_12 §#37) to keep endGI O(1) (BL-10).      Call after endGI for each ended GI. O(n_aggregators + n_auditors), bounded      by MAX_REGISTERED_AGGREGATORS and MAX_REGISTERED_AUDITORS. Idempotent      guard: reverts on a second call for the same GI (registrationSlotsReleased).

params._GI: GI whose participants' registration slots should be released.            Must be a GI that has already ended (< current GI, or == current GI            with state GIended).

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

resolveDispute(uint256,uint8,uint256,boo.details: Upheld: a fresh aggregator subgroup is assigned and the      resolution clock starts; the bond credit is deferred to      settleRecomputation()/expireDispute() rather than paid here (see      those functions' NatSpec). Bounty top-up (task_100926_12 #43):      out of scope — DinTreasury's withdrawERC20 is onlyOwner, so task      contracts cannot pull a bounty from it. The challenger currently      only reclaims their bond. Flagged for Umer: the fix requires      either an authorized-withdrawer role on DinTreasury or an      alternate bounty source (forfeited-stake pool).      Rejected (frivolous): fully closed immediately — bond is split      50% burn / 50% treasury per MECHANISM_DESIGN.md §4.      treasuryAccrued accumulates the full bond for observability      regardless of whether the transfer succeeds.

params._GI: GI index the disputed batch belongs to.
params.batchId: Index of the disputed batch within its tier.
params.tierKind: Whether the batch is a Tier-1 or Tier-2 batch.
params.upheld: True if the dispute is found valid.

setDINTaskAuditorAsSlasher().details: The DIN-Representative must have called DinCoordinator.addSlasherContract      for the auditor address before this function is called.

setDINTaskAuditorContract(address).details: One-shot: reverts if called after the initial setup step.

setDINTaskCoordinatorAsSlasher().details: The DIN-Representative must have called DinCoordinator.addSlasherContract      for this address before this function is called.

params._disputeBond: Token amount a challenger must post to open a dispute.
params._disputeWindow: Seconds after batch finalization during which a dispute can be opened.
params._resolutionWindow: Seconds the fresh subgroup has to recompute after being assigned.

params._genesisModelIpfsHash: CID of the genesis model weights, encoded as bytes32.

params._floor: Gas units derived from `commitAuditScore + revealAuditScore`               measurements (worst-case auditor path per GasSimulation S2).

setS2SlashFractionBps(uint256).details: Only affects AGG_T*_NO_SUBMISSION slashes. BAD_CONSENSUS slashes      keep the full minStake() amount regardless of this setting.      Setting to 10000 restores the previous flat-minStake behavior.

setTestDataAssignedFlag(uint256,bool).details: Must be called while GI state is AuditorsBatchesCreated.

params.flag: True once test datasets have been distributed to auditors.

setTier2Score(uint256,uint256).details: Permitted during T2AggregationDone or GenesisModelCreated states.

params._score: Quality score for the Tier-2 aggregated model.

setTreasuryAddress(address).details: Storage only -- no forwarding happens yet since DinTreasury doesn't      exist on develop. See treasuryAccrued.

params._treasuryAddress: Address of the future DinTreasury deployment.

params.confirmed: True if the fresh subgroup's recomputation confirmed                  the original CID was wrong (dispute stands).                  False if recomputation matched the original CID                  (original aggregators were right, dispute dismissed).

slashAggregators(uint256).details: Slash amount equals minStake() at call time. Each affected aggregator      emits an AggregatorSlashed event with the actual amount deducted.

params._GI: Current GI index, used to guard against stale calls.
Expected next GI index (must equal current GI + 1).
Expected next GI index (must equal current GI + 1).
params.score: New pass score to set on the paired DINTaskAuditor.

startLMsubmissionsEvaluationReveal(uint2.details: Must run strictly after commits close and before any reveal is      accepted -- see DINTaskAuditor.revealAuditScore's GIstate gate.

submitT1Aggregation(uint256,uint256,byte.details: Caller must be an assigned, active aggregator who has not already submitted.      Votes are tallied per CID; the majority CID is selected at finalization.

params._aggregationCID: IPFS CID of the aggregated model weights, encoded as bytes32.

submitT2Aggregation(uint256,uint256,byte.details: _batchId must be 0. Caller must be an assigned, active aggregator who      has not already submitted.

params._aggregationCID: IPFS CID of the final aggregated model, encoded as bytes32.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

aggregatorWeight(uint256,address).notice: Per-aggregator count of finalized T1/T2 batches they were         assigned to in a GI, one increment per (aggregator,         finalized-batch) pair. Preserves the reward weighting         _collectFinalizedBatchAggregators used to express by emitting         a duplicate array entry per pair (task_210726_6 §3): an         aggregator assigned to a finalized batch is rewardable for it         regardless of whether they personally matched consensus,         since a mismatch already cost them stake via slashAggregators.         Accumulated incrementally in finalizeT1Aggregation /         finalizeT2Aggregation's existing per-batch loop (BL-10, #125)         and read at claim time by DINTaskAuditor.claimReward.

autoCreateTier1AndTier2(uint256).notice: Partitions active aggregators and approved models into Tier-1 batches         and creates a single Tier-2 batch from the remaining validators.

claimDisputeBond().notice: Claims a reclaimed dispute bond after an upheld dispute.

closeLMsubmissions(uint256).notice: Closes the local model submission window.

closeLMsubmissionsEvaluation(uint256).notice: Closes the LMS evaluation reveal phase and finalises audit         results on the paired DINTaskAuditor.

constructor.notice: Deploys the coordinator and sets the validator stake contract.

createAuditorsBatches(uint256).notice: Delegates auditor batch creation to DINTaskAuditor and advances GI state.

endGI(uint256).notice: Marks the current Global Iteration as complete and settles         its reward pool.

expireDispute(uint256,uint8,uint256).notice: Times out a dispute whose fresh subgroup did not recompute         within the resolution window.         Callable by anyone after the resolution deadline — silence is         not free for the fresh subgroup.         Outcome: dispute dismissed (original CID stands); challenger         bond returned (the fault is the fresh subgroup's, not theirs);         fresh subgroup slashed for liveness failure.

finalizeT1Aggregation(uint256).notice: Closes the Tier-1 submission window and selects the majority CID         for every batch.

finalizeT2Aggregation(uint256).notice: Closes the Tier-2 submission window and selects the majority CID.

getDINtaskAggregators(uint256).notice: Returns the list of aggregators registered for the given GI.

getTier1Batch(uint256,uint256).notice: Returns the full details of a Tier-1 batch.

getTier2Batch(uint256,uint256).notice: Returns the details of the single Tier-2 batch for the given GI.

getTier2Score(uint256).notice: Returns the Tier-2 quality score recorded for the given GI.

modelId().notice: Model registry ID this coordinator manages.

openDispute(uint256,uint8,uint256).notice: Opens a dispute against a finalized Tier-1 or Tier-2 batch.

registerDINaggregator(uint256).notice: Registers the caller as an aggregator for the current GI.

registrationSlotsReleased(uint256).notice: Guard: prevents releaseGIRegistrationSlots from being called         twice for the same GI (which would double-decrement counters).

releaseGIRegistrationSlots(uint256).notice: Decrements the concurrent-registration counter on DinValidatorStake         for every aggregator and auditor that participated in the given GI.

resolveDispute(uint256,uint8,uint256,boo.notice: Resolves a dispute, either upholding or rejecting it.

s2SlashFractionBps().notice: S2 liveness-fault slash fraction in basis points (0–10000).         Applied to missed-submission slashes (AGG_T*_NO_SUBMISSION) only.         Bad-consensus faults (AGG_T*_BAD_CONSENSUS) keep a full minStake()         amount — they imply an active incorrect submission, not a liveness         failure, so they are treated as full-severity faults.         30% default matches S1. DAO-settable via setS2SlashFractionBps.

setDINTaskAuditorAsSlasher().notice: Confirms that the paired DINTaskAuditor is registered as a slasher,         completing the setup sequence and enabling model registration.

setDINTaskAuditorContract(address).notice: Sets the paired DINTaskAuditor contract for this model.

setDINTaskCoordinatorAsSlasher().notice: Confirms that this coordinator is registered as a slasher on the         validator stake contract, advancing the GI state.

setDinToken(address).notice: Sets the ERC20 token used for dispute bonds.

setDisputeParams(uint256,uint64,uint64).notice: Sets the three dispute timing/bond parameters.

setGenesisModelIpfsHash(bytes32).notice: Records the genesis model IPFS hash, enabling GI 1 to be started.

setNetworkFeeFloor(uint256).notice: Sets the minimum gas-cost floor (in gas units) each validator must         be covered for per GI.  The DAO reads the measured number from         GasSimulation tests and posts it here; model owners should deposit         enough rewards to cover `networkFeeFloor × nValidators` before GI start.

setS2SlashFractionBps(uint256).notice: Updates the S2 liveness-fault slash fraction.

setTestDataAssignedFlag(uint256,bool).notice: Propagates the test data assignment flag to DINTaskAuditor.

setTier2Score(uint256,uint256).notice: Records the Tier-2 aggregation quality score for the current GI.

setTreasuryAddress(address).notice: Sets the address forfeited dispute bonds will eventually be forwarded to.

settleRecomputation(uint256,uint8,uint25.notice: Final verdict after the fresh subgroup has recomputed.         Owner calls this as the normal adjudication path (within the         resolution window) or as a last-resort fallback after it         (e.g. if the fresh subgroup itself produced no quorum).         confirmed=true slashes only the original batch's aggregators         whose own submission matched the disputed `finalCID` --         dissenters and non-submitters are excluded (the latter are         already penalized separately via slashAggregators()).

slashAggregators(uint256).notice: Slashes aggregators in both Tier-1 and Tier-2 batches that failed         to submit or submitted a CID that did not match the consensus.

slashAuditors(uint256).notice: Triggers auditor slashing on the paired DINTaskAuditor contract.

startDINaggregatorsRegistration(uint256).notice: Opens the aggregator registration window for the current GI.

startDINauditorsRegistration(uint256).notice: Opens the auditor registration window on the paired DINTaskAuditor.

startGI(uint256).notice: Starts the next Global Iteration, retaining the existing pass score.

startGI(uint256,uint256).notice: Starts the next Global Iteration and updates the auditor pass score.

startLMsubmissions(uint256).notice: Opens the local model submission window for the current GI.

startLMsubmissionsEvaluation(uint256).notice: Opens the LMS evaluation COMMIT phase so auditors can begin         committing (hidden) scores via DINTaskAuditor.commitAuditScore.

startLMsubmissionsEvaluationReveal(uint2.notice: Closes the commit phase and opens the REVEAL phase (task_210726_6         §2a) so auditors can call DINTaskAuditor.revealAuditScore.

startT1Aggregation(uint256).notice: Transitions GI state to T1AggregationStarted, opening the         Tier-1 submission window for assigned aggregators.

startT2Aggregation(uint256).notice: Opens the Tier-2 aggregation submission window.

submitT1Aggregation(uint256,uint256,byte.notice: Submits an aggregation result CID for a Tier-1 batch.

submitT2Aggregation(uint256,uint256,byte.notice: Submits an aggregation result CID for the Tier-2 batch.

tier1BatchCount(uint256).notice: Returns the number of Tier-1 batches created for the given GI.

totalAggregatorWeight(uint256).notice: Sum of aggregatorWeight across all aggregators for a GI --         the settlement denominator for aggregator reward shares.         Snapshotted into DINTaskAuditor at settleRewards time (#125).
